body.text: A Russian‑owned cargo vessel, the Sparta II, was towed out of Finnish waters after a drone strike set it ablaze, Finland’s coastguard said.
Finnish defence officials said Ukraine was likely behind the attack, and the prime minister warned that ‘war is spilling over into our immediate vicinity’.
The 16 crew members were evacuated onto a nearby Russian ship, while the vessel remained on fire, according to reports.

key_facts.text: Finland’s coastguard confirmed the towing of the Sparta II after the drone strike.
Ukraine was identified as the likely source of the drones.
All 16 crew members were safely evacuated.

I 16 membri dell’equipaggio sono stati evacuati su una nave russa vicina, mentre la nave è rimasta in fiamme, secondo i resoconti.
